verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements layer built on Stripe, so payout reconciliation is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no payout, bank-deposit or balance-transaction endpoints. Its "balance" APIs refer to customer feature and credit balances, which is a different concept and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
